conditions.label: Above Magicka %
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor's magicka is at or above {param1}%.

conditions.label: Below Magicka %
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor's magicka drops below {param1}%.

conditions.label: Above Stamina %
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor's stamina is at or above {param1}%.

conditions.label: Below Stamina %
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor's stamina drops below {param1}%.

conditions.label: In Combat
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor is in combat (engaged in active fight).

conditions.label: Enemies Alerted
conditions.description: Triggers when hostile NPCs within {param1}m are alerted to the actor.

conditions.label: Hostile Nearby
conditions.description: Triggers when at least one hostile NPC is within {param1}m.

conditions.label: On Hit
conditions.description: Triggers with a {param2}% chance per matching incoming hit of class {param1}.

conditions.label: Above Health %
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor's health is at or above {param1}%.

conditions.label: Below Health %
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor's health drops below {param1}%.

conditions.label: Indoors
conditions.description: Triggers whenever the actor is inside any interior cell.

conditions.label: Outdoors
conditions.description: Triggers whenever the actor is in an exterior worldspace.

conditions.label: Location
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor is inside a {param1}-flagged location.

conditions.label: Weather
conditions.description: Triggers when the current weather class is {param1}.

conditions.label: Sprinting
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor is sprinting.

conditions.label: Running
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor is running (not walking, not sprinting).

conditions.label: Weapon Drawn
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor has a weapon or spell drawn.

conditions.label: Lover's Embrace
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor has the Lover's Embrace rested bonus active.

conditions.label: Sneaking
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor is sneaking.

conditions.label: Swimming
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor is swimming.

conditions.label: Mounted
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor is mounted on a horse or other steed.

conditions.label: Bleeding Out
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor is downed and bleeding out.

conditions.label: Time of Day Range
conditions.description: Triggers between in-game hours {param1} and {param2} (wraps midnight if end is earlier than start).

conditions.label: Is Player's Follower
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor is one of the player's current followers.

conditions.label: Burning (fire MGEF)
conditions.description: Triggers while a fire-keyword magic effect is active on the actor (burning).

conditions.label: Frozen (frost MGEF)
conditions.description: Triggers while a frost-keyword magic effect is active on the actor (frozen).

conditions.label: Shocked (shock MGEF)
conditions.description: Triggers while a shock-keyword magic effect is active on the actor (shocked).

conditions.label: Invisible
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor is invisible.

conditions.label: Has Active Follower
conditions.description: Triggers when at least one follower NPC is within {param1}m.

conditions.label: Gold >= N x 1000
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor's gold is at or above {param1},000.

conditions.label: Wearing Heavy Armor
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor is wearing a heavy-armor cuirass.

conditions.label: Wearing Light Armor
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor is wearing a light-armor cuirass.

conditions.label: While Casting Spell
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor is charging or holding a spell mid-cast.

effects.description: Shifts the actor's maximum stamina by {param1}.

effects.description: Shifts the actor's bow draw and release speed by {param1}.

effects.label: Muffle
effects.description: Toggles silenced footsteps on the actor while active.

effects.label: Waterbreathing
effects.description: Toggles waterbreathing on the actor while active.

effects.description: Toggles water-walking on the actor while active.

effects.label: Add Bounty
effects.description: Burst — adjusts the actor's bounty in their current hold by {param1} gold (positive adds, negative pays off).

effects.label: Modify Armor
effects.description: Toggles a flat armor-rating bonus of {param1} while active.

effects.label: Detect Life
effects.description: Toggles a Detect Life aura that highlights living NPCs within {param1}ft while active.

effects.label: Slow Time
effects.description: Toggles a slow-time effect that drags everything around the actor to {param1}% of normal speed while active.

effects.label: Flame Cloak
effects.description: Toggles a flame cloak that burns enemies within {param2}ft for {param1} damage/s while active.

effects.label: Frost Cloak
effects.description: Toggles a frost cloak that chills enemies within {param2}ft for {param1} damage/s while active.

effects.label: Lightning Cloak
effects.description: Toggles a lightning cloak that shocks enemies within {param2}ft for {param1} damage/s while active.

effects.label: Flash
effects.description: Flashes the tattoo's emissive layer to {param2}% brightness on the chosen trigger event ({param1}).

effects.label: Modify Spell Absorb
effects.description: Shifts the actor's chance to absorb incoming spells by {param1}%.

param1.label: Spell absorb chance shift (points; + absorb, - vulnerable)

effects.label: Modify Reflect Damage
effects.description: Shifts the actor's chance to reflect incoming melee damage by {param1}%.

param1.label: Reflect damage chance shift (points; + reflect, - vulnerable)

effects.label: Modify Skill
effects.description: Shifts the actor's {param1} skill by {param2} points.

effects.label: Vanilla Shader
effects.description: Plays the {param1} effect shader on the actor while active (duration {param2}s; 0 = until removed).

effects.label: Vanilla Sound
effects.description: Plays the {param1} looping sound on the actor while active (duration {param2}s; 0 = until removed).
